This mod will add some items that are not in the main game.

I missed my food pixel work; it's been a while since I messed with 1.6 migrate. I hope those are useful and my skill will improve.

JA It's no longer compatible with my first mod; it might be fixed later.[/list]


[img]https://img2.pic.in.th/pic/mod-detail.png[/img]


[size=5]Warning Spoiler.1.0:[/size]


Added new plants: pork, beef, chicken, and cocoa flower. (Actually, it's just like cocoa pod but I prefer the flower.)
You can buy them in Pierre's general store.Pork, beef, and chicken are crops.
The cocoa tree is a big sapling. I really adore this style of tree, just like the fairy tale thing.


[img]https://img5.pic.in.th/file/secure-sv1/CocoaTree.png[/img]


Isn't that cute and aesthetic?



Also, with some products like bacon, ham, cocoa powder, tea powder, noodles, and ketchup, you can cook.
Uncraftable product: pepper, salt, and shoyu; you can get them in Pierre's too!




[img]https://img5.pic.in.th/file/secure-sv1/installation0ab35fda186f0489.png[/img]


[/list][list=1]
1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Content Patcher
3. Download the mod file, unzip it, and then paste it in Mods.[/list][/center][list=1]
